resolved_findings.title: Blind-screen report is not validated against full indexed coverage or recomputed hits
resolved_findings.detail: Release checks dependency hash strings, then only traverses the report-supplied corpora list. An empty/partial corpus list, wrong candidate_count, or remaining hits combined with cleared quarantine lists can pass. split_groups only checks internal agreement of the quarantine sets, not agreement with hits or index coverage.
resolved_findings.evidence: Synthetic main() negative probes accepted a candidate for empty_corpora, cleared_quarantine_with_hit, and wrong_coverage. Reads, hash providers and output writer were mocked to synthetic fixtures; no protected corpora or candidate files were opened.
resolved_findings.requested_change: Fail closed on exact report schema, full indexed corpus/coverage/candidate counts, and hits-to-group closure. Prefer actual blind screener replay against frozen inputs and comparison of the complete saved report before release, without emitting protected payloads.
resolved_findings.resolution: verify_screen now executes the isolated blind screener and compares the complete report exactly.

resolved_findings.title: Tool token audit can be omitted while release still passes
resolved_findings.detail: Release validates candidate_sha256/status/no_truncation only. It does not require token statistics or exact action/tool example counts and token maxima. Reports with tokens removed or tool count zero are accepted.
resolved_findings.evidence: Synthetic main() negative probes missing_tokens and zero_tool_count each accepted the tool candidate. Existing audit generation encodes both task kinds, but release accepts an incomplete or edited audit and does not independently enforce coverage.
resolved_findings.requested_change: Require exact action count equal to all rows, exact tool count equal to tool-labeled rows, strict finite/integer bounds and maxima within the configured token limit; bind tokenizer/config dependencies and ideally recompute the audit before release. Add negative release-gate tests.
resolved_findings.resolution: verify_tokens now recomputes e.token_stats across all action rows and actual tool rows using the local tokenizer, then compares exact statistics; encode rejects >2048 without truncation.

actual_candidate_verification.full_new_row_review_chain: structural check passed for current A+B records; final frozen-review SHA binding is performed by root finalizer
